transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. How can I help you today?

I, uh, I guess I'm just having some trouble sitting still. Like, whenever I have to stay put in the radiology suite at work, or even just in class, I get this feeling like... like I'm crawling out of my skin. I've tried to just tough it out for months now, but I always end up pacing around, or shifting in my seat, or just finding some excuse to get up and move. It's getting pretty bad.
Do you ever feel a strong, uncontrollable need to move your legs, especially when you're sitting or lying down?
Uh... no, I don't think so. It's not really a... leg thing. I just... I just get restless. That's all.
Do you often feel anxious or worried when you're trying to sit still, or does the restlessness happen even when you're feeling calm?
Um... no. Not really anxious or anything. It just... happens. Like, even if I'm perfectly calm, I just... I still can't stay in the chair. That's pretty much it.
Does this restlessness happen in other situations too, like when you're at home watching TV or reading, or is it mostly when you have to sit still for work or class?

Yeah... it's pretty much everywhere. Even if I'm doing stuff I actually like, um... like editing photos or sketching. I just... I can't keep it quiet for very long. I'll start tapping, or humming... talking to whoever is nearby. Or just getting up a bunch. People at home or in the lab usually end up telling me to settle down... so, yeah.
Do you often find it hard to focus on details, or do you feel like your mind wanders a lot even when you're trying to concentrate on something?
Um... no, not really. I don't think my mind wanders that much. I mean... I can focus fine. It's just... the sitting still part that's hard.
When you think back to when you were a child, do you remember feeling this same kind of restlessness, or have you mostly noticed it more recently?

Um... yeah. It's not recent. My parents actually... they still talk about elementary school conferences. I guess teachers were always saying I was out of my seat. Or, um... calling out, rushing ahead before they even finished giving directions. So... yeah. It was happening way before middle school. It definitely didn't just start with my radiology training. It's just... always been there.
Do you often feel the need to fidget, tap your hands or feet, or move around a lot even when you're not particularly restless or uncomfortable?
Um... yeah, I guess. I mean, I kind of already said that. I'm always tapping or moving my feet. It's just... what I do.
Do you ever have trouble organizing tasks or keeping track of what you're supposed to be doing, even if you're trying to focus?
Um... no. Not really. I don't really have a problem with that. I can keep track of things fine. It's... yeah, organization isn't the issue.
